Recurrent readings are the tribute denarius as image/ownership/allegiance (Caesar vs. humans as God’s image-bearers), the lost coin as a valued soul, thirty pieces as betrayal/blood money, widow’s mites as sacrificial devotion, and money generally as mammon or stewardship test.",
  "book_summary": "The stamped image: a person as the owner’s minted image-bearer—dug, refined, struck with the NAME; priced by law and ransomed at the flat half-shekel; lost and sought by lamplight; undervalued by man’s mint at slave-damages for the Shepherd, while God’s scales prefer the widow’s whole living.",
  "consensus_core_identification": "Unsettled, multi-valent monetary symbols whose chief poles are image-bearing ownership, a lost soul of value, betrayal price, and sacrificial or mammon value.",
  "book_core_identification": "The person as God’s stamped/minted image-bearer (ransomed, recovered, and differentially valued).",
  "core_relation": "COMPATIBLE_OVERLAP",

  "boundary_disagreement": "Book reclassifies every major coin pericope (tribute, lost coin, thirty pieces, widow’s mites, temple-tax coin) plus the half-shekel ransom and person-valuation laws as facets of one person-as-image-bearer metaphor; consensus keeps the passages distinct by context and never elevates Ex 30/Lev 27.",
  "material_contradiction": "None; the image-bearer and lost-soul readings are retained, only subordinated to a tighter synthesis.",
  "rationale": "The book’s central claim that the coin is the person stamped as the owner’s image-bearer is already the primary meaning in Response A and a common alternative or implication across B–D (tribute analogy + lost-coin allegory). It refines that core by (a) systematically folding in the half-shekel atonement money, person-vow valuations, minting process imagery, and the dual valuation of Christ/widow, and (b) treating every other coin text as an aspect of the same person-coin rather than as independent symbols. This is a material change of extension and boundary without replacement of the central image-bearer identification, producing REFINED rather than MATCH, DIVERGENT or NOVEL.",
